messages.text: Old server rules (a glimpse into the COVID Minehut era):

messages.author: sacred-rose
paragraphs: The goal of this server is to build a permanent world and have fun. Students should be able to take a break, come back next summer, and still see their home standing. Be civil. Consequences may vary. Wheaton's law applies and joining the discord is necessary.
This is a space for college-aged adults and up, so respect everyone's time and effort after a long day.

messages.author: sacred-rose
items: You are responsible for your damage (creeper holes, boss fights, water messes, etc.)
Don't desecrate the landscape unless you know it's not there "for show" (like a mountain that's part of someone's home)
Don't disgrace yourself by leaving floating trees
No weapons of mass destruction in local areas, like someone's home
You can explore but keep in mind it'll prob lag everyone else if you go to unexplored chunks so try to go in groups
^^ EDIT 2025, the server is now hosted on a more powerful machine, and exploring is encouraged!
Redstone machines may break if you unload the chunk so use at your own risk
